file.notApplied: The settings file on disk is not applied

auth.accountDetail: Your name, password and second factors.
auth.membersDetail: Who uses Meet, and their role: members start and join meetings and skip the lobby, IT (viewers) also see every meeting and the server, editors are tokens for Calendar and Chat, admins also manage members and tokens.
auth.signinDetail: How people sign in: passwords, and identity providers with OIDC. The groups they send decide who may record.
auth.tokensDetail: Tokens for scripts and other products, each with a role and an end date. Calendar and Chat need one with the editor role to make meeting links.
auth.itOnlyDetail: The server, the integrations and the settings are for members with the viewer role or higher.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.descriptionAll: every meeting on {{host}} today, from Calendar, Chat or a link made by hand.
meetings.descriptionMine: your meetings on {{host}} today: the ones you organise, are invited to or joined.
meetings.joinedDetail: People who joined, of those invited. Guests came in through the lobby.
meetings.roomDetail: A link that stays yours, for calls that are not in the calendar.
meetings.roomGuests: Guests wait in the lobby and get in only while you or someone from {{organization}} is in the room.
meetings.badLink: This is not a meeting's link or code.

start.title: Meeting of {{name}}
start.readyDetail: Anyone with the link can ask to join. People from {{organization}} come straight in; everyone else waits in the lobby until you let them in.
start.allowedFor: Allowed for the {{group}} group in meet.yaml. Everyone in the call sees when a recording runs.
start.recordingOff: No one records here: meet.yaml has no recording part.
start.neverFor: Not for the {{group}} group in meet.yaml.
start.notInGroup: meet.yaml allows recording only for some groups, and you are in none of them.

call.beforeJoinDetail: You are signed in, so you come straight in. Guests from outside {{organization}} wait in the lobby until someone lets them in.
call.noSuchMeetingDetail: Check the link, or ask whoever sent it for a new one.
call.recordingNowDetail: Everyone in it sees a red mark while the recording runs. Join only if that is fine with you.
call.connectFailed: Could not reach the media server
call.noDevices: The browser did not open the camera or the microphone. Allow them in the address bar, then turn them on below.
call.guestsWhile: Guests get in only while someone from {{organization}} is in the call.
call.recordNote: Recording is allowed for this meeting because you are in {{group}}. It starts only when you press Record, and everyone sees a red mark while it runs.
call.chatGone: Messages are deleted when the meeting ends.

left.title: You left the meeting
left.removed: You were taken out of the meeting
left.notKept: When the last person leaves, the chat is deleted and nothing of the call is kept: it was not recorded.
left.recorded: When the last person leaves, the chat is deleted. The recording is kept for as long as meet.yaml says, then deleted.

guest.noSuchMeeting: Check the link, or ask whoever invited you for a new one.
guest.askDetail: Someone from {{organization}} lets you in from the lobby.
guest.name: Your name
guest.emailDetail: If you like: it tells them you are the one invited.
guest.kept: Your name and email are kept only until the call ends. Nothing else about you is stored.
guest.waitingDetail: Someone from {{organization}} sees that you are here and lets you in. Keep this page open.
guest.letInWaitingDetail: You were let in. You join as soon as someone from {{organization}} is in the call.
guest.deniedDetail: Someone in the meeting did not let you in. Ask whoever invited you.
guest.expiredDetail: No one answered in time, or the meeting ended.
guest.noGuests: Only people with an account join here
guest.noGuestsDetail: Meetings here are for people from {{organization}} only. Sign in to join.
guest.recorded: Everyone in it sees a red mark while the recording runs. Ask to join only if that is fine with you.
guest.signIn: Sign in to skip the lobby

recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.description: A meeting is recorded only where meet.yaml allows it and its organiser presses Record. Everyone in the call sees it, and people joining later are told before they come in.
recordings.ofMeetings_one: of {{count}} meeting in the last 30 days
recordings.ofMeetings_other: of {{count}} meetings in the last 30 days
recordings.ofDisk: of {{size}} GB on the recordings disk
recordings.diskUnknown: the recordings disk is not mounted here
recordings.fromFile: From meet.yaml; changed by IT, not here.
recordings.deleteDetail: The file is removed from the server now, before its deletion date. It cannot be brought back.

server.title: Server
server.description: The media server and TURN in your install. Calls never leave {{media}} and {{turn}}.
server.descriptionNoTurn: The media server in your install. Calls never leave {{media}}.
server.upTo_one: up to {{count}} at once in meet.yaml
server.upTo_other: up to {{count}} at once in meet.yaml
server.noCapacity: no link speed set in meet.yaml
server.chartDetail: Mbit/s, both directions, every 15 minutes, as the browsers count it
server.chartLabel: Bandwidth through the media server and through TURN today
server.perMeetingValue: Up to {{people}} people, video up to {{video}}
server.noTurn: No TURN listeners in meet.yaml to check.

turn.udp: For networks that block direct media
turn.tls: Looks like web traffic; gets through hotel and guest networks

server.turnCredentials: Short-lived credentials: LiveKit gives them only to people in a meeting, with their token.
server.noConnections: No one is in a call.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: LiveKit carries the calls; Meet asks it for rooms and tokens, hears its webhooks, and lets Calendar and Chat make links.
integrations.livekit: The media server: rooms, participants and access tokens.
integrations.noSecret: No API secret: set the variable meet.yaml names for livekit.api_secret.
integrations.webhooksDetail: Who joins and leaves, and recordings done, as it happens. Without them Meet still asks every 15 seconds.
integrations.egress: Records rooms to MP4 files where meet.yaml allows it.
integrations.metricsDetail: CPU, memory and how long it has run, for the Server page.
integrations.groupsDetail: Who may record follows groups: those in meet.yaml, and those the identity provider sends at sign-in.
integrations.idpGroups_one: {{count}} person signed in with groups from the identity provider.
integrations.idpGroups_other: {{count}} people signed in with groups from the identity provider.
integrations.turn: LiveKit's own TURN, for networks that block direct media.
integrations.calendarChatDetail: They make a meeting link for an invitation or a channel with a Meet token that has the editor role.

settings.title: Settings
settings.readOnly: {{file}} is the only way to change these
settings.readOnlyDetail: Change the file, review it like code, and Meet reads it again within a minute. A file with a mistake leaves the last good version in place.
settings.noFile: No file: Meet runs with its defaults.
settings.livekitDetail: Where Meet reaches LiveKit, and where browsers do.
settings.guestsOn: Ask to join through the lobby
settings.recordingDetail: The groups whose organisers may record, and how long the files are kept.
settings.noGroups: None in the file; the identity provider's groups still count.
